Aisha G.: noticed unusual p95 spikes in ap-south this morning around 03:14 — looks tied to egress-queue-fill on a handful of racks. Could be tenant throttles interacting with dedicated pool backpressure.
Tom R.: I see that. egress_tx_qlen spiked then we started soft-throttling tenants X and Y; their retries caused more small requests -> amplifier effect.
infra-bot: ALERT: egress-queue-high rack=ap-south-2 qlen=243 threshold=200
Vikram S.: Classic noisy-neighbor feedback loop: throttle -> client retry -> more small allocations -> proxy enqueues -> preemptions. We need to break the retry loop or change throttle policy.
Aisha G.: Proposal: 1) enable token-bucket shaping per-tenant on the egress to smooth bursts; 2) add jittered backoff header so SDKs don't retry in lockstep; 3) temporarily increase preempt threshold to avoid mass handoffs.
Tom R.: For quick mitigation I'll bump preempt threshold on ap-south-2 to avoid mass moves. Vikram, can you add per-tenant token-bucket config?
Vikram S.: Yes — will deploy shaping with rate=300Mbps and burst=50MB on canary rack. Also instrument `retry-after` header usage so we know if clients respect it.
Aisha G.: Watchlist: p95 latency, egress qlen, per-tenant retry rate. Open INFRA-2457 and link runbook.
infra-bot: DEPLOYMENT: egress-shaper v1.0 -> canary-ap-south-2 by Tom R. at 03:25 UTC
Tom R.: Canary 10m: qlen dropped from 243 -> 48, p95 back to baseline, retry-rate for tenant X down 82%. Rolling to other racks in region unless objections.
Vikram S.: Follow-ups: add SDK guidance for jittered retries and expose `retry-after` in API. Also add alert rule: if retry_rate spikes >3x baseline then auto-enable shaper for that tenant.
Aisha G.: Agreed. I'll draft the note to product and SLA owners about risk tradeoffs. Closing watch after rollouts.
